(Japanese: '''ポケットモンスターSPECIAL ルビー・サファイア 1''' ''{{tt|Pocket Monster Special|Pokémon Adventures}} Ruby Sapphire volume 1'') is the first volume of an omnibus compilation of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga authored by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and illustrated by [[Satoshi Yamamoto]].

This volume is released under [[Shogakukan]]'s "My First Series" (マイファーストシリーズ) brand, which are bargain-priced volumes sold only in Japanese convenience stores. It has no connection to the discontinued [[My First Wide: Pocket Monsters Special Ruby Sapphire Chapter volume 1|2011 omnibus release]] of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}.

==Major events==
{{spoilers}}
* {{Adv|Ruby}} moves from [[Johto]] to [[Littleroot Town]] in [[Hoenn]].
* Ruby arrives at his new house, but quickly runs away.
* Ruby meets [[Professor Birch]].
* Ruby meets {{Adv|Sapphire}}.
* Sapphire is revealed to own a Pokédex.
* Ruby and Sapphire make a bet to see who can beat their respective goals in eighty days.
* Ruby meets {{adv|Wally}}.
* Ruby helps Wally capture his first Pokémon, a {{p|Kecleon}}.
* Ruby is swept out to sea after an earthquake.
* [[Gabby and Ty]] are attacked by [[Team Aqua]]'s {{p|Ludicolo}}.
* Sapphire defeats [[Team Aqua]], but they successfully steal the [[Devon Parts|Devon Goods]].
* [[Mr. Stone]] gives Sapphire a letter for {{Steven}}.
* Ruby is rescued by [[Mr. Briney]] at sea.
* Ruby meets [[Steven Stone]].
* Ruby and Sapphire reach the [[Abandoned Ship]].
* Sapphire and Ruby battle against [[Courtney]] and [[Tabitha]].
* Courtney and Tabitha get away with the Detector.
* Ruby and Sapphire go their separate ways.
* Ruby lures [[Blaise]] onto the Submarine Explorer 1.
* Ruby escapes from the [[Submarine Explorer 1]].
